notes: Grow from the Ashes (kicked), printed: 'search your library for two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.' The lands ENTER the battlefield, so Tatyova, Benthic Druid ('Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life and draw a card') triggers once for each of the two lands: seat 0 gains 2 life (20 -> 22) and draws 2 cards (after the shuffle, from whatever is on top).
